description:
In this episode of “I’d Like to Know”, Pastors Stephen Bohr, C.A. Murray, and David Salazar dive into two detailed Bible questions about the nature of the soul and the prophetic fulfillment of Ezekiel 9.

📘 Bible Question Answered every Tuesday at 4 PM PT on SUMtv — real struggles, real answers, rooted in Scripture.

⏱️ Timestamps & Topics

01:10 – What’s the difference between “nephesh” and “ruach”?
Are “soul” and “spirit” the same in Genesis 2:7 and Ecclesiastes 12:7? Why does Scripture use two different Hebrew words to describe the life force and the part that returns to God? The pastors explore these verses to clarify what truly happens when we die — and why understanding these words matters.

16:48 – Has Ezekiel 9:6 already been fulfilled? Or is it still future?
A viewer asks if this verse was fulfilled during the Babylonian destruction of Jerusalem, or if Ellen G. White teaches it points to a future event for God’s people. The pastors compare biblical history, prophetic writings, and EGW quotes to provide a clear answer.

📖 These questions help us build a solid biblical foundation on life, death, prophecy, and the final judgment.
